lines.text: Ollie the young owl knew fascinating facts about stars, acorns, and forest geography!
Whenever a friend began telling a story, Ollie hooted right over them to share his thoughts!
Yesterday I found a cool pebble—began mouse! WELL I FOUND A METEORITE! shouted Ollie!
Soon, his animal friends felt unheard and stopped inviting Ollie to their fireside chats!
Wise Grandpa Owl told him, You have two big ears and only one beak for a very good reason!
Listening carefully lets you discover amazing things you never would have known on your own!
At the next campfire, Ollie waited patiently, nodding along as mouse finished her story!
Being a great listener makes people feel valued and turns casual buddies into best friends!
Listen with your heart and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
